Coverage_Description: VHIS-certified medical rider reimbursing eligible medical expenses worldwide (psychiatric treatment in Hong Kong only), with 3 ward levels, itemized annual benefit limits but no ov; optional Extra Medical Plan covers excess eligible costs at 100% (network) or 80% (non-network)
customer requirement: Hong Kong residents; must be attached to a basic plan
price structure: Annual renewable, non-guaranteed premium; adjusted at renewal by age, sex, ward level, and Extra Medical Plan option
additional informations: Qualified premium tax deduction up to HK$8,000 per insured per year; 15% no-claim discount after 36 consecutive claim-free months; can switch to VHIS Standard Plan at renewal without re-underwriting
